tasks.label: Build & Run RideBookingSystem
args: chcp 65001 > $null; g++ -g -Iinclude -finput-charset=UTF-8 -fexec-charset=UTF-8 main.cpp src/Driver.cpp src/Passenger.cpp src/Ride.cpp src/FileHandler.cpp src/LinkedList.cpp src/Stack.cpp src/Queue.cpp src/Graph.cpp src/RideBookingSystem.cpp -o bin/ridebookingsystem.exe; & ./bin/ridebookingsystem.exe; Read-Host 'Press Enter to exit...'
